result.reason: The addition reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, export within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and written deletion certification. It is broader than necessary because it applies the return obligation to all Company materials and Confidential Information, rather than only Company Data; some such items may not be capable of machine-readable return. The deletion language also omits “materials” and does not specify when certification must occur. These issues reduce precision but do not defeat the playbook requirements or materially alter the existing termination economics.
